title: Parametric CAD Bench v2 submission manifest
description: Pointer to public Harbor Hub jobs, the exact trial-selection key, and self-declared summary metrics that maintainers re-derive during review.

version.description: Increment when re-submitting the same (handle, agent, model) tuple after fixing issues.

submitted_at.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the manifest was filed.

email.description: Optional contact email for verification follow-up.

tag.description: The only benchmark version currently accepting submissions.

dataset_content_hash.description: Immutable Harbor content hash for gnucleus-ai/cad-bench@v2.

name.description: Short slug for the agent (e.g. codex, claude-code, mini-swe-agent).

display_name.description: Human-readable agent label shown on the Harbor leaderboard.

display_url.description: Public product or source URL linked from the agent column.

version.description: Exact version string. For closed-source agents, a build identifier is fine.

import_path.description: Optional Python import path for custom Harbor adapters (informational).

reasoning_effort.description: Exact reasoning-effort setting used for the run.

auth_mode.description: Authentication mode used by the agent for this run.

id.description: Exact LiteLLM-style model id used (e.g. openai/gpt-5.5, vertex_ai/gemini-3.1-pro).

display_name.description: Human-readable model label shown on the Harbor leaderboard.

display_url.description: Public model documentation URL linked from the model column.

endpoint.description: Optional endpoint URL if non-default. Maintainers use this to verify trajectory plausibility.

source_jobs.description: The single public Harbor Hub job supplying the complete 100-task cohort.

agent.description: Exact Harbor agent name selecting trials from source_jobs.

agent_version.description: Exact Harbor agent version selecting trials from source_jobs.

model.description: Exact provider/model identifier selecting trials from source_jobs.

reasoning_effort.description: Exact reasoning-effort value selecting trials from source_jobs.

repo.description: Optional archival Hugging Face dataset id.

runs_prefix.description: Optional archive path corresponding to the Harbor source jobs.

mean_reward.description: Claimed mean continuous Harbor reward across the 100-task cohort, counting failed or unscored trials as zero. Maintainers re-derive it.

trials_per_task.description: Parametric CAD Bench v2 requires exactly one trial per task.

total_trials.description: The complete v2 cohort contains exactly 100 trials.

n_errors.description: Unscored trials, including crashes, timeouts, and trials without a finite Harbor reward. This becomes metrics.n_errors on the live leaderboard.

cost_usd.description: Optional. Maintainers re-derive from token counts × published pricing; the leaderboard uses the re-derived value.

notes.description: Optional free-form notes — harness tweaks, known limitations, agent quirks.
